Bill.BriefDescription: Studying the use of Paine Field for commercial air service.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of Paine Field for commercial passengerair service; creating a new section; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Snohomish county or in the alternative, theSnohomish county economic development council, may conduct an initialfeasible air study of commercial passenger air service at Paine Field. The elements studied must include, but are not limited to: (1) Determining the service market area; (2) Commercial passenger air service market and feasibility; (3) The level of service that could be provided at Paine Field; (4) Determining the customer base from the public, business, andgovernment; (5) A comparison of market size to other small state airports suchas Bellingham, Olympia, TriCities, Wenatchee, and Yakima; (6) The potential cost savings to the public, business, andgovernment; and (7) The potential economic impact to Snohomish county. The county shall send its report to the legislature by December 1,2004.

The sum of one hundred thousand dollars, oras much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated as a capitalbudget item for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2004, from the generalfund to the department of community, trade, and economic developmentsolely for distribution first to Snohomish county or, in thealternative, to the Snohomish county economic development council, tocarry out the purposes of this act. This appropriation is intended tosupplement other funds that may be available.
